puzzle.title: ECHO ROOT PARTITION
clues: FORMAT: the code is a date written MMDD.
The date is the LAST RESET listed in operator record 000.
Operator 000 was reset exactly once per summer. Check the archive file 'op000.rec'.
There are no letters in the code. Only four digits.

trace.title: ORIGINAL SIGNAL
output: The first signal came from inside NEXUS.

lesson.txt: Well done, {player}. You just used the three commands you will type a thousand times:
ls          list what is in the current folder
cd <dir>    walk into a folder (cd .. walks back out)
Some files hide. Their names start with a dot and 'ls' skips them.
Next: run 'ls -a' in this folder and read the hidden file you find.
.keycard: Real servers are full of these: old notes, keys, forgotten backups.
Last lesson: you can copy a file to your own machine with 'download <file>'.
field_notes.dat: 1. Every action raises the TRACE ALERT a little. Mistakes raise it a lot.
2. When the alert gets high: 'disconnect' and let it cool down.
3. Stuck? Type 'hint'. It always names your next step.
4. 'mission' shows your orders, 'help' lists every command.

readme.txt: ECHO is a sandboxed training node maintained by NEXUS Tactical Operations.
Everything here is safe. Everything here is monitored.
ls            list files            cat <file>   read a file
cd <dir>      change directory      scan         inspect this node
Hint: some files are hidden. 'ls -a' will show them.

note.txt: if you are reading this, ECHO let you in. good. it doesn't let everyone.
take package.dat. it holds the keys to BLACKVAULT's backup account.
the passphrase is encoded. you'll figure it out: decode <text>
don't tell your handler where you got it.
